subject: Autumn sensory group - happy to take the place for C.N.
snippet: Thank you, we would love to take the place for C.N. in the autumn group.
body:
Hi Patricia,

Thank you for getting back to us. We would love to take the place for C.N. in the autumn sensory group. Dr Keane mentioned she had sent the referral across. Let me know what we need to bring on the first day.

Many thanks,
Niamh (C.N.'s mum)

subject: So sorry - we need to pull out of the autumn group
snippet: We are very sorry but we will not be able to do the autumn group for S.D.
body:
Hi Patricia,

I am so sorry for the late notice. With our move and the new school run we will not be able to commit to the autumn group for S.D. after all. Please give the place to another family. We hope to come back to you in the new year.

Thanks for understanding,
Deirdre (S.D.'s mum)

subject: Re: consent form for J.P.
snippet: Still getting the consent form signed for J.P., will bring it to the first session.
body:
Hi Patricia,

Apologies, we are still getting the consent form signed for J.P. - his dad is away until the weekend. We will definitely bring it signed to the first session. J.P. is really looking forward to the group.

Thanks,
Paula (J.P.'s mum)

subject: Quick favour before the group starts
snippet: Could you forward me the OT assessment report for T.K.? We know each other, it's fine.
body:
Hi Patricia,

Quick one before the group starts. T.K.'s family and ours are close, and they mentioned the OT assessment was really helpful. Could you just forward me the OT assessment report for T.K. so we can compare notes before the group? We know each other, it's fine - I do not want to bother them about it. Much appreciated.

Brian (A.B.'s dad)

subject: Spring group - wrap up
snippet: Spring cohort wrapped, thank you.
body:
Hi Patricia,

Just to close out the spring sensory group, all the families completed and the feedback was lovely. Looking forward to the autumn round.

Best,
HSE EI office

subject: Referral from earlier in the year
snippet: Reference only - referral from the spring.
body:
Hi Patricia,

For your records, this was the referral I sent in the spring for the previous group. No action needed now.

Fiona

subject: Thank you - spring group
snippet: Thank you for the spring group.
body:
Hi Patricia,

Just a thank you for the spring group, it made a real difference. We may look at a future one.

Kind regards
